messages.useSlashes: Use `//` lines for a JSDoc block of one or two lines.
messages.useJsdoc: Use one `/** */` block for three or more consecutive `//` lines.

docs.description: Use `//` for short comments and JSDoc blocks for longer prose.

messages.propertiesOnNewline: Destructuring properties must go on a new line if they aren't all on the same line.

docs.description: Keep destructuring patterns either compact or fully expanded, never half-split.

messages.specifiersOnNewline: Export specifiers must go on a new line.

docs.description: Put each export specifier on its own line.

messages.mustSplitMany: Imports must be broken into multiple lines if there are more than {{maxItems}} elements.
messages.mustSplitLong: Imports must be broken into multiple lines if the line length exceeds {{maxLineLength}} characters.
messages.mustNotSplit: Imports must not be broken into multiple lines if there are {{maxItems}} or less elements.
messages.limitLineCount: Import lines must have one element per line.
messages.noBlankBetween: Import lines cannot have blank lines between them.

docs.description: Split import lists when they get crowded or too long.

messages.moveAfterImports: Top-level type/interface declarations must be placed after imports, before runtime code.

docs.description: Keep top-level interfaces and type aliases together, after imports and before runtime code.

messages.mustSplit: Properties must be broken into multiple lines if there are more than {{maxProperties}}.
messages.noBlankBetween: Properties cannot have blank lines between them.
messages.consistNewline: Properties must be put on newlines.
messages.multilineProperty: Multiline property must be put on newlines.

docs.description: Keep crowded destructuring patterns, interfaces, and type literals on separate lines.

messages.duplicateProp: The {{name}} prop is already on this element; React keeps the last occurrence silently.

docs.description: Report duplicate JSX props on the same element.

messages.noDestructureNamespace: Do not destructure namespace imports; import only specific members needed.

docs.description: Avoid destructuring namespace imports when a named import is enough.

messages.preferArrow: Prefer using arrow functions over plain functions
messages.preferExplicit: Prefer using explicit returns when the arrow function contains only a return
messages.preferArrowHoisted: Prefer arrow functions, but this one is used before it is declared. Converting it to `const` would throw at runtime, so move the usage below the declaration first, then this fixes itself.

docs.description: Prefer arrow functions when the conversion keeps behaviour the same.
Prefer `await` to `.then()`, `.catch()`, and `.finally()` when reading Promise values.

messages.destructure: Destructure the props in the signature instead of reading them member by member.

docs.description: Destructure component props in the function signature instead of reading them one field at a time.

messages.preferTryCatchOverCatch: Wrap the await in `try`/`catch` instead of handling the rejection with `.catch()`.
messages.preferTryCatchOverThenHandler: Wrap the await in `try`/`catch` instead of passing a rejection handler to `then`.

docs.description: Prefer `try`/`catch` around an awaited rejection path instead of a promise callback.
Keep hook dependency arrays in a consistent order.

messages.complexUnionNewline: Union containing object or function types must have each member on a new line.
messages.genericUnionNewline: Union in generic type argument must split when more than {{maxGenericMembers}} members.

docs.description: Split union types when object or function members make them hard to read.
